description: Connection credentials (BaseCredentials.key for ApiKey, BaseCredentials.SAS for SAS; GetConnectionWithCredentials) and the dataset storage SAS URI (SasCredential.sasUri; GetDatasetCredentials, DatasetsStartPendingUploadVersion) grant access to the target, but the spec has no sensitive mark. Mark them sensitive so they decode as Redacted. Patch file name sorts after BaseCredentials.json, which adds key and SAS.
